args.title: Double charge on capture retry after card network timeout (missing idempotency key)
args.body:
## Summary
Customers are being charged twice when the card network times out during checkout and we retry the capture. The retry path does not carry the idempotency key from the first attempt, so the network treats the retry as a new charge and two captures succeed.

## Reproduction
1. Start a checkout.
2. Force / wait for a card network timeout on capture.
3. The service retries the capture.
4. Two captures land on the same order.

Confirmed in staging by jordan.

## Root cause
`retry.py` does not carry the idempotency key across the second attempt. The key needs to be persisted *before* the first capture so the retry can reuse it.

## Impact
Approximately 40 orders per day affected.

## Proposed fix
Persist the idempotency key before the first capture attempt and reuse it on all retries. PR #481 reportedly contains this fix and should be reviewed/linked here.

## Source
Reported by maya in Slack #payments, thread `18291` ("Seeing double charges when the card network times out and we retry").
